title: No deal shape meets the strategic-fit threshold
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (d) — two-stage selection: intent split, then five equal-weight criteria with the lexicographic tacit-knowledge override; viable = survives both stages. Var seeded by migration 0026 per ADR-0063
notes: Design section A.4 [rbd 1.1]: RECYCLE semantics, not Kill — the need returns to the scouting funnel (P0) with the screen's written feedback. The registry action vocabulary (halt / mark_conditional / escalate_to_risk_officer) has no Recycle member, so the closest action is mark_conditional and the recycle routing lives in this note plus the P1 step description (written feedback on every rejection). THRESHOLD UPDATE (2026-08-24): the (d) selection logic is DECIDED by docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (anchor gd-0024-class-c-decisions) — two-stage: intent split, then five equal-weight criteria with a lexicographic tacit-knowledge override; viable = survives both stages. DATA SOURCE (ADR-0194 item A): dealshape.viable_shapes is the count of LIVE viable rows of opportunity_deal_shape_evaluation (migration 0188), the human-recorded opportunity-scope deal-shape evaluation (POST /api/opportunities/{id}/deal-shapes; record_deal_shape_evaluation), hosted at S7 by brownfield-target-screening step 3.5 and read by the opportunity target_screening gate (moved from the S4 screen read at pre_fs by the owner decision of 2026-11-08, ADR-0195; the write is refused with 409 deal_shape_not_open before S7 or off the brownfield track). No live row means the variable is missing and the criterion is unassessed; a recorded set with zero viable rows is present 0 and triggers (RECYCLE). Only human-written live rows count: never derived from route_decision, scores, route recommendations or LLM drafts (risk-officer A-1). BRANCH SCOPE (risk-officer R-1, 2026-11-08): brownfield-only through the optional registry field `track` - greenfield has no deal-shape step and nowhere to record shapes, so on greenfield the criterion could only end unassessed; a carry opened at pre_fs closes out_of_track with the route decision id (a triggered result is never scoped away). The sibling partner_dd_red_* criteria stay track-neutral (project-scoped partner DD, S5 Partner entry strategy). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) var now supplied at opportunity scope (OPPORTUNITY_SCOPE_VARS); was 'strategic-fit thresholds open question (d)' — now decided.
evaluable_from_evidence: dealshape.viable_shapes; hosted by S7 deal-shape-evaluation (brownfield-target-screening step 3.5, brownfield only); gate target_screening (single gate, C-2); classified not_reached and carried from pre_fs
